{{nihongo|'''Kawachi Kunitama Shrine'''|河内国魂神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Settsu Province]].

It is a {{ill|Shikinaisha|fr|Shikinaisha|zh|式內社|qid=Q134917286|lt=Shikinaisha}}, and its former rank under the {{ill|Q712534|lt=Modern shrine ranking system}} was {{ill|Gō-sha|Q134917316|qid=Q134917316}}. It was formerly called “Gomō Tenjin” or “Gomō Tenjinsha.”

“Gomō” is said to derive from the old local place name “Gomau.”

=== Enshrined deities ===
The shrine enshrines {{ill|Ōkuninushi|lt=Ōnamuchi-no-Mikoto|qid=Q276944}}, {{ill|Sukunabikona|ca|Sukunabikona|fr|Sukunabikona|it|Sukuna-hikona|ja|スクナビコナ|ko|스쿠나비코나|mni|ꯁꯨꯀꯨꯅꯕꯤꯀꯣꯅ|pl|Sukunabikona|pt|Sukunahikona|simple|Sukunabikona|sv|Suku-Na-Bikona|zh|少彥名|qid=Q3275687|lt=Sukunahikona-no-Mikoto}}, and {{ill|Sugawara no Michizane|ar|سوغاوارا نو ميتشيزانه|br|Sugawara no Michizane|ckb|سوگاوارا نۆ میچیزانێ|de|Sugawara no Michizane|es|Sugawara no Michizane|fa|سوگاوارا نو میچی‌زانه|fi|Sugawara no Michizane|fr|Sugawara no Michizane|id|Sugawara no Michizane|it|Sugawara no Michizane|ja|菅原道真|kk|Сугавара но Митидзане|ko|스가와라노 미치자네|la|Sugawara no Michizane|ms|Sugawara no Michizane|nl|Sugawara no Michizane|nn|Sugawara no Michizane|pl|Michizane Sugawara|pt|Sugawara no Michizane|ru|Сугавара-но Митидзанэ|sh|Sugawara no Michizane|sv|Sugawara no Michizane|th|สึกาวาระ โนะ มิจิซาเนะ|tr|Sugawara no Michizane|uk|Суґавара но Мітідзане|zh|菅原道真|zh_classical|菅原道真|zh_min_nan|Sugawara no Mitizane|qid=Q382005}}. It does not enshrine {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Amahikone-no-Mikoto}}, ancestral deity of the {{ill|Ōshikōchi clan|ja|凡河内氏|qid=Q11395444}} ({{ill|Funi-kawachi-no-Kuni-no-Miyatsuko|ja|凡河内国造|qid=Q11395443}}), nor his child {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Amemikage-no-Mikoto}}.

=== History ===
In the Kyōhō era, in ''{{ill|Five Kinai Chronicles|ja|五畿内志|qid=Q11372555|lt=Nihon Yochi Tsūshi Kinai-hen}}'' (Gokinaishi), {{ill|Namikawa Seisho|ja|並河誠所|qid=Q6563872}} identified Gomō Tenjin with Kawachi Kunitama Shrine worshiped by the Oshikōchi clan. In September {{ill|1736|ab|1736|af|1736|als|1736|am|1736 እ.ኤ.አ.|an|1736|ar|1736|ary|1736|arz|1736|ast|1736|avk|1736|az|1736|azb|۱۷۳۶ (میلادی)|ba|1736 йыл|ban|1736|bar|1736|bcl|1736|be|1736|be_x_old|1736|bg|1736|bn|১৭৩৬|bo|༡༧༣༦ལོ།|bpy|মারি ১৭৩৬|br|1736|bs|1736.|ca|1736|cdo|1736 nièng|ce|1736 шо|ceb|1736|ckb|١٧٣٦|crh|1736|cs|1736|csb|1736|cv|1736|cy|1736|da|1736|de|1736|diq|1736|el|1736|eml|1736|eo|1736|es|1736|et|1736|eu|1736|fa|۱۷۳۶ (میلادی)|fi|1736|fo|1736|fr|1736|frp|1736|frr|1736|fur|1736|fy|1736|ga|1736|gan|1736年|gcr|1736|gd|1736|gl|1736|gv|1736|he|1736|hi|१७३६|hif|1736|hr|1736.|hsb|1736|ht|1736 (almanak gregoryen)|hu|1736|hy|1736|hyw|1736 թուական|ia|1736|id|1736|ilo|1736|io|1736|is|1736|it|1736|ja|1736年|jv|1736|ka|1736|kaa|1736|kk|1736 жыл|kn|೧೭೩೬|ko|1736년|krc|1736 джыл|la|1736|lb|1736|lez|1736 йис|li|1736|lij|1736|lmo|1736|lt|1736 m.|lv|1736. gads|mai|१७३६|map_bms|1736|mdf|1736|mg|1736|mhr|1736|mi|1736|min|1736|mk|1736|mr|इ.स. १७३६|mrj|1736 и|ms|1736|my|၁၇၃၆|myv|1736 ие|mzn|۱۷۳۶|nah|1736|nap|1736|nds|1736|nds_nl|1736|new|सन् १७३६|nl|1736|nn|1736|no|1736|nrm|1736|nso|1736|oc|1736|olo|1736|or|୧୭୩୬|os|1736-æм аз|pa|1736|pl|1736|pnb|1736|pt|1736|qu|1736|ro|1736|ru|1736 год|rue|1736|sa|१७३६|sah|1736|scn|1736|sd|1736ع|se|1736|sh|1736.|shn|1736|si|1736|simple|1736|sk|1736|sl|1736|smn|1736|sq|1736|sr|1736|su|1736|sv|1736|sw|1736|szl|1736|ta|1736|te|1736|tg|Соли 1736|th|พ.ศ. 2279|tk|1736|tl|1736|tr|1736|tt|1736 ел|uk|1736|ur|1736ء|uz|1736|vec|1736|vi|1736|vls|1736|wa|1736|war|1736|wuu|1736年|xmf|1736|yi|1736|zh|1736年|zh_min_nan|1736 nî|zh_yue|1736年|qid=Q6989}} ({{ill|Genbun|Q1145754|qid=Q1145754}} 1), local village headmen were summoned to the Osaka magistrate and reportedly had the name imposed on them by force.

About 2.5 km east, in Mikage, {{ill|Higashinada-ku, Kobe|Q277434|qid=Q277434}}, behind {{ill|Tsunashiki Tenman Shrine|Q17229186|qid=Q17229186|lt=Tsunashiki Tenman Shrine}}, there is a hilly area called Mikage-yama; there is also a theory that this may have been the true Kawachi Kunitama Shrine.
